identification: Three pairs of women's handmade leather shoes by Preston Zly (Melbourne designer footwear brand, still trading): (1) orange-red leather ankle boots with fur/shearling-style trim, purple-black toe caps and chunky heel, side zip; (2) gold metallic leather button-front/cut-out flat boots with side zip; (3) pale green silk/satin-look flat Mary Janes with red lining and red stitching. Armitage says size 7. Single photo.

viewing_check: Estimate 50-80, no bid shown when checked. The brand has real resale (A$40-290 per single pair, typical about A$60-140 in the last 3 years, most 2024-2026). These three pairs look worn and some older-style (gold boots look 1990s/2000s), so check soles, insole stamp, size (7 AU = about EU 38) and condition. Resale of a worn pair is about A$60-130 each at best, 3 pairs could be A$150-350 gross if all sell, with postage and effort. Prices roughly flat, no clear trend.
